packages.name: EthOS Backup Manager
packages.description: Versioned backups for folders and Docker Compose projects. Dated hardlink snapshots, GFS retention, quick/deep verify, a restore wizard and optional rclone offsite replication — in a native EthOS window.
packages.author: SyncHot
packages.changelog: 1.0.3: requires EthOS 2.0. 1.0.2: legacy generations show their real size and file count after indexing; unknown sizes render as — instead of 0 B. 1.0.1: the window now uses the shared AntiVirus/Domains shell — 218 px rail, text-only nav, panels, summary tiles, tables, tag pills and the same light/dark tokens. 1.0.0: first release — dated rsync hardlink snapshots, 7/4/6 GFS retention, completion manifest, quick and deep verify, cancel and queued runs, restore in place or to another folder, Docker Compose project discovery with volume/image snapshots, and rclone mirror with 30-day remote history.

packages.name: Domains
packages.description: Reverse proxy with free, automatically renewed HTTPS certificates. Point your own domains at this NAS and forward them to any host and port - another device, a container, or EthOS itself - without touching nginx by hand. Caddy issues and renews Let's Encrypt certificates on its own, and the stack keeps routing even when EthOS is restarting.
packages.author: SyncHot
packages.changelog: 1.2.1: requires EthOS 2.0. 1.2.0: the window follows the AntiVirus layout — a left rail with Overview, Routes, Certificates, Settings and Diagnostics, status pills, stat tiles and action cards. Routes show their options as chips, the form keeps headers/Host/streaming under Advanced, and the ACME email field is no longer overwritten by the background refresh. 1.1.1: read certificates from Caddy's actual storage root (/data/caddy/certificates), so the certificate list and expiry show up. per-route response headers and permanent redirects, plus a bulk route import so an existing proxy configuration (for example Nginx Proxy Manager) can be migrated in one step. 1.0.0: initial release: Caddy-based reverse proxy with automatic Let's Encrypt certificates, per-domain routes to any host:port (including EthOS itself), WebSocket and streaming support, live certificate expiry, a DNS preflight check and the proxy log in one native EthOS window.

packages.name: EthOS Download Manager
packages.description: HTTP, magnet and debrid downloads with a priority queue, categories, a daily schedule, bandwidth limits and RSS rules — in a native EthOS window.
packages.author: SyncHot
packages.changelog: 1.1.0: provider slots — a torrent debrid (Real-Debrid / AllDebrid / TorBox) and a hoster-link provider (AllDebrid / tb7.pl) can be active at the same time; the Settings panel lists every provider from the engine catalogue with its own credential fields, Verify button and (for tb7.pl) premium/transfer status and supported hosters; requires EthOS 2.9.0. 1.0.13: per-package speed limit — every package row has a Limit selector (off / 1-50 MB/s) that caps the whole multi-part package with a shared budget instead of each part; requires EthOS 2.3.12. 1.0.12: per-part Skip / Unskip — a broken volume of a multi-part package can be excluded from its part row (and put back later) instead of being deleted, skipped parts are tagged in the package row and never counted as failures; requires EthOS 2.3.11. 1.0.11: mirror / hoster failover — the add form takes alternative URLs (one per line), a dead source or an exhausted retry budget switches to the next mirror with a fresh budget and a restart from byte 0, and the row shows mirror n/m; requires EthOS 2.3.10. 1.0.10: archives unpack themselves after the download when Extract archives after download is on — multi-part packages wait for every part and start at the first volume, Delete archives after a successful extraction is a separate switch, finished rows and packages gain an Extract / Extract again action and show Extracting… / Extracted / Extract failed; requires EthOS 2.3.9. 1.0.9: transient failures retry automatically with exponential backoff (the row shows retry n/max in …), a Retry failed toolbar action re-queues every error, Settings gained retry count/delay and the duplicate policy (rename/skip/overwrite), and re-adding the same URL now says Already in the list; requires EthOS 2.3.8. 1.0.8: packages expand with Show parts — each part keeps Resume/Delete/Details. 1.0.7: multi-part archives group into one JDownloader-style package row; requires EthOS 2.3.6. 1.0.6: declares the optional archive-tools host requirement, so EthOS installs bsdtar (libarchive-tools) for .7z/.rar extraction of downloaded archives; requires EthOS 2.3.5. 1.0.5: bulk Clear failed — removes every errored download record and its leftover .part data (finished files and destination folders stay); requires EthOS 2.3.4. 1.0.4: Package Center icon redrawn on the 256 px grid; requires EthOS 2.0. 1.0.3: queue ordering works everywhere — whole waiting/paused rows are draggable, ↑/↓ buttons reorder without dragging, a Queue order sort shows the real start order, and a bug that hid the action buttons on every row after the first is fixed; adds Pause all / Resume all / Clear completed and the auto-download-debrid toggle. 1.0.2: matches the shared package shell — a persistent Download button in the window header, a ready/attention status card, numbered add form (source · destination · torrents), table-based categories/RSS/watch folders and a Package panel; the 2 s poll no longer clears the quick-add field. 1.0.1: debrid keys can be verified without re-typing them (the backend uses the saved key for a masked value), provider errors are shown verbatim (e.g. Real-Debrid bad_token, AllDebrid auth errors, TorBox /user/me), and admin-only saves explain the 403. 1.0.0: first release — live queue with drag-and-drop ordering, pause/resume/reset/delete, add via URL, magnet or .torrent, categories, a daily start window, global/per-task speed limits, debrid provider setup, qBittorrent key management, RSS rules and watch folders.

packages.name: EthOS AntiVirus
packages.description: ClamAV antivirus with a native EthOS window: full, custom and scheduled scans, quarantine copies, scan logs and configurable scan options. Read-only scans of /home, /mnt and /media; signatures update automatically.
packages.author: SyncHot
packages.changelog: 2.1.5: scans report progress in the shared task panel instead of only the status line; requires EthOS 2.0. 2.1.4: Browse… in the scan target and schedule forms uses the EthOS folder picker, restricted to /home, /mnt and /media. 2.1.3: health/status report which shares are visible in the scanner container and the UI warns instead of failing scans silently. 2.1.2: fix scans failing with 'not visible in the scanner container' — the UI container now mounts /home, /mnt and /media read-only at /scan. 2.1.1: light and dark themes follow the EthOS appearance toggle. 2.1.0: Synology-style options — quarantine copies, whitelist/file-type/size filters, smart scan, scan log, scheduled scans, definition info and a persistent package data volume. 2.0.1: Package Center icon. 2.0.0: native EthOS window UI; package service bound to loopback and reached through an authenticated proxy. 1.0.1: clearer first-start status and longer scan timeout.

packages.name: Books
packages.description: Read EPUB and PDF books and listen to audiobooks that already live on your NAS. Folders are browsed through the EthOS file API, so nothing is copied and your permissions still apply; covers and your place in every title are kept per account.
packages.author: SyncHot
packages.changelog: 1.1.0: shared folders and individual titles from other accounts — a “Shared with me” section in Folders & Scan and the library, read-only scanning and playback, and a Share button on your own scan folders (requires EthOS 2.13.3). 1.0.0: first release — a library for EPUB, PDF and audiobooks with per-account progress. Add one or more folders, scan them through the EthOS file API (no copying, no extra share access), and read in a paginated or scrolled reader with light, sepia and dark themes. Audiobooks play from .m4b files or folders of .mp3/.flac tracks with resume, speed, skip and a sleep timer. Covers, titles, authors and series are extracted in the browser; the package service stores metadata only.

packages.name: Disk Cleaner
packages.description: Find what is eating your disk: scans caches, thumbnails, logs, trash and old downloads, shows the biggest space users and lets you delete them safely. The scan and delete operations stay in EthOS, where they run through the file service's path scope, so this package ships the desktop app only.
packages.author: SyncHot
packages.changelog: 1.0.1: light theme was white-on-white and is fixed; Browse… uses the EthOS folder picker; scans, deletes and journal vacuum report progress in the shared task panel; the Biggest files view parses again. 1.0.0: first release. The Disk Cleaner desktop app moves out of the core install; every delete still goes through EthOS's scoped file service.

packages.name: Docker Manager
packages.description: Engine status, containers, images, volumes and Compose projects in one place: start, stop, restart, inspect logs, prune and install Docker Engine on the NAS. The engine helper and the /api/docker endpoints stay in EthOS because the package runtime depends on them; this package is the desktop app.
packages.author: SyncHot
packages.changelog: 1.0.5: fix Up/Down/Destroy and the other confirmation prompts — they called the callback-based ctx.modal.confirm as if it returned a Promise, so clicking the button threw and no request was sent. 1.0.4: show authorization errors clearly and report pull/prune progress while requests run. 1.0.3: scope actions and data lookups to each Docker Manager window; remove global inline handlers. 1.0.2: window redesigned with the shared AntiVirus/Domains shell — 218 px rail with text-only nav, summary tiles, one simple table per section and an engine panel that states the next step; dialogs use the shared modal. 1.0.1: Package Center icon redrawn on the 256 px grid; requires EthOS 2.0. 1.0.0: first release. The Docker Manager desktop app moves out of the core install; the Docker Engine helper, the compose runtime and the /api/docker endpoints stay in EthOS because every container package depends on them.

packages.name: Code Editor
packages.description: A VS Code-style workbench in the browser: single files or whole folders, tabs and breadcrumbs, search, Source Control with inline git gutters, split terminals, Problems/Output panels and an AI chat tab. File access stays in EthOS behind its path scope, so this package ships the desktop app only.
packages.author: SyncHot
packages.changelog: 1.0.1: light code theme (VS Code Light+ tokens and chrome), the terminal follows the appearance toggle, and unsaved changes show in the status bar instead of overriding the window title; requires EthOS 2.0. 1.0.0: first release. The Code Editor desktop app moves out of the core install; editing, git and terminal endpoints stay in EthOS, and File Station still opens files in it.

packages.name: Git Diff
packages.description: Side-by-side diff with partial (hunk and line) staging, commit box, pull/push and recent history for any Git repository on your shares. Opening a diff from the Code Editor's Source Control panel focuses this app. Repository access stays in EthOS, behind its path scope.
packages.author: SyncHot
packages.changelog: 1.0.1: requires EthOS 2.0. 1.0.0: first release. The Git Diff desktop app moves out of the core install; the git endpoints stay in EthOS's editor API, so the Code Editor keeps handing diffs to it.

packages.name: Kanban Board
packages.description: Boards, columns and cards with drag and drop, labels, due dates and a card editor. Now a Packages app: the board lives in the package's own service and keeps working for every signed-in account. Boards from the built-in version are imported automatically on first start.
packages.author: SyncHot
packages.changelog: 1.0.2: description renamed in the EthOS 2.0 naming. 1.0.1: requires EthOS 2.0. 1.0.0: first release. The Kanban board moves out of the core install into Package Center, using a private Python environment with no third-party dependencies. Boards from the built-in app are imported on first start.

packages.name: Media Enhancements
packages.description: Face-aware video thumbnails for Files: picks the frame with the largest face and crops around it instead of using a random shot. OpenCV runs in a private environment that only this package installs. Without this package thumbnails still work — EthOS falls back to the first valid frame.
packages.author: SyncHot
packages.changelog: 1.0.2: description renamed in the EthOS 2.0 naming. 1.0.1: requires EthOS 2.0. 1.0.0: first release. Face detection for movie thumbnails moves out of the EthOS core into this package (OpenCV ~130 MB stays out of the core venv). File Station calls it locally and falls back to the first valid frame when it is not installed.

packages.name: Music
packages.description: Spotify-style player for your NAS: search and stream from YouTube, a downloaded library, playlists, likes, radio stations and podcasts, all shared with the EthOS Music Android app. The music API stays in EthOS so the phone keeps working; this package ships the desktop app. Install “Music Engine” for search, streaming and downloads.
packages.author: SyncHot
packages.changelog: 1.0.2: share playlists with other accounts — a sharing card in Settings, a “Shared with me” section and read-only playlist playback (requires EthOS 2.13.3). 1.0.1: light and dark themes follow the EthOS toggle; feedback now goes to the global Notification Center instead of a package toast; downloads report progress in the shared task panel. 1.0.0: first release. The Music desktop app moves out of the core install; it requires the Music Engine package, which Package Center installs automatically. Your library, likes, playlists and podcast subscriptions stay in EthOS and remain shared with the Android app.

packages.name: Music Engine
packages.description: YouTube search, streaming and downloads for the Music app and the EthOS Music Android app. yt-dlp runs in a private environment that only this package installs, offline from a pinned wheelhouse; EthOS talks to it locally and the core install stays lean. Install it once and Music works exactly as before.
packages.author: SyncHot
packages.changelog: 1.0.1: requires EthOS 2.0. 1.0.0: first release. yt-dlp moves out of the EthOS core into this package, so Music keeps working while the core install no longer carries the extractor. Updates ship through Package Center.

packages.name: Photos
packages.description: Photos for your NAS: a timeline of every photo and video on your shares, albums, favourites, a private PIN-protected section and a full-screen viewer. The gallery index stays in EthOS (the EthOS Photos Android app reads it too); this package ships the desktop app, so it can update on its own.
packages.author: SyncHot
packages.changelog: 1.0.3: share albums with other EthOS accounts — a share action on every album, a “Shared with me” album section and a read-only shared view (requires EthOS 2.13.3). 1.0.2: description renamed in the EthOS 2.0 naming. 1.0.1: Add folder uses the EthOS folder picker, and moving items to trash reports progress in the shared task panel. 1.0.0: first release. The Photos desktop app moves out of the core install into Package Center; the gallery index, albums and private section keep living in EthOS, so the Android Moments app is unaffected and photos are still indexed without this package.

packages.name: Samba Shares
packages.description: Manage SMB shares, per-user and group access rules, and Samba credentials for existing Linux accounts. Includes permission masks, service status, and safe folder selection. Samba account changes use a narrow EthOS helper; this package ships the desktop app only.
packages.author: SyncHot
packages.changelog:
1.3.0: complete native window with permission masks, structured user/group ACLs, and Samba password management for existing Linux accounts. Failed service reloads restore the prior config and show an error.
1.2.1: light theme, package-window refresh, and EthOS folder picker. 1.2.0: Samba host dependency managed through the root helper.
1.1.0: missing-dependency state. 1.0.0: first release.

packages.name: Sticky Notes
packages.description: Per-account notes and checklist tasks: search, pin, archive, due dates, reminders with browser push, and a collapsible right-edge desktop ribbon.
packages.author: SyncHot
packages.changelog: 2.0.0: checklist tasks, search, pin, archive, due dates and reminders with Web Push; a per-account right-edge desktop ribbon with quick capture; requires EthOS 2.14.1.

packages.name: Cameras
packages.description: Watch your IP cameras from EthOS: MJPEG live grid, per-camera motion detection with event thumbnails, snapshots and MP4 recordings. The camera service stays in EthOS (ffmpeg, motion threads, path-scoped recordings) so recordings keep running headless; this package ships the desktop app.
packages.author: SyncHot
packages.changelog: 1.0.2: renamed to Cameras as part of the EthOS 2.0 product naming (ids and APIs unchanged). 1.0.1: requires EthOS 2.0. 1.0.0: first release. The Surveillance desktop app moves out of the core install; cameras, motion detection and recordings stay in EthOS, so recording continues even without this package.

packages.name: Video Station
packages.description: Browse and watch the videos on your NAS: a cinema library with poster shelves, Continue Watching, Movies/Series, search and My List; HLS playback for HEVC/AC3/MKV on desktop and phones; resume, subtitles, keyless metadata (Cinemeta/TVmaze) with optional TMDB, and a media-engine panel (VA-API/QuickSync/software). The video API stays in EthOS so the Android Video app keeps working.
packages.author: SyncHot
packages.changelog: 2.3.1: the download version picker also knows 480p · tiny (the new EthOS default). Requires EthOS 2.19.0. 2.3.0: multi-select in Movies, Library and Search — press Select, tap posters (or Select all) and Download queues every chosen film in your default version. Requires EthOS 2.18.0. 2.2.0: new Downloads page with the NAS queue — see every queued, preparing, ready and saved film, cancel or delete a job, and save a prepared file to this computer; a version picker on the movie page (Original / 1080p / 720p) plus the default version in Settings (shared with the Videos phone app). “Original” copies the video instead of re-encoding it when the file allows it, so a download can take seconds. Requires EthOS 2.16.0. 2.1.3: shared folders and their videos now appear directly on the Home tab in “Shared folders” and “Shared with you” shelves — no need to open the Shared tab first; shared titles are marked read-only and cannot be added to My List (requires EthOS 2.13.3). 2.1.2: playback fixes — asks the server for the audio codec this browser can decode (AAC, Opus, or video-only with a notice) and always uses hls.js when Media Source is available, so Safari/Android Chrome no longer fail on the bounded live window. The player logs the real error, retries once, shows the reason with a "Try again" button, and frees a session that arrives after the window closed. movies that showed a black screen and "The stream could not be played" play again — AAC muxed from E-AC-3 "5.1(side)" tracks (the usual layout in WEB-DL rips) is now normalised to a standard 5.1 layout, which Chrome accepts. The player also logs the real error, retries the stream once and shows the reason with a "Try again" button. 2.1.0: metadata works without an API key — Cinemeta (movies and series, posters/backdrops/rating/cast) plus TVmaze (official series fallback), with an optional TMDB key for Polish titles and overviews. New provider picker, per-source health check, missing/re-fetch-all actions, source attribution and automatic bounded metadata fetch. Requires EthOS 2.13.0. 2.0.0: new cinema UI (full-bleed top nav, backdrop hero, poster shelves, detail pages, bottom tab bar on phones), server-side HLS playback for HEVC/AC3/MKV with VA-API/QuickSync hardware decode and encode, a real media-engine panel with probe diagnostics, working quality/audio/subtitle pickers, server-side My List, responsive touch layout and lazy poster loading. Requires EthOS 2.12.0. 1.0.2: renamed to Videos as part of the EthOS 2.0 product naming (ids and APIs unchanged). 1.0.1: light theme for the shell, rows and empty states (the hero and player stay cinematic), and adding a folder uses the EthOS folder picker. 1.0.0: first release.

packages.name: EthOS Welcome
packages.description: A tiny static welcome page for your NAS, served by nginx on port 8090.
packages.author: SyncHot
packages.changelog: 1.0.3: Package Center now offers Open UI for the page on port 8090; requires EthOS 2.0. 1.0.2: light and dark themes, honours the ?theme= passed by EthOS and falls back to prefers-color-scheme. 1.0.1: Package Center icon. 1.0.0: initial release: static welcome page with a live clock.

packages.name: Tic-Tac-Toe
packages.description: A tiny two-player tic-tac-toe game that opens directly in an EthOS window. No container, no port.
packages.author: SyncHot
packages.changelog: 2.1.1: requires EthOS 2.0. 2.1.0: light and dark themes follow the EthOS appearance toggle. 2.0.1: Package Center icon. 2.0.0: native EthOS window UI; no nginx container and no port. 1.0.0: initial nginx version.

packages.name: EthOS VM Manager
packages.description: Run Windows and Linux virtual machines on this NAS with hardware acceleration. Create a VM from an ISO or boot a ready-made system image such as the EthOS OS release, use it from the browser console, and let it start again with EthOS.
packages.author: SyncHot
packages.changelog: 1.2.0: edit machines. Every stopped machine has an Edit button: rename it, change vCPU and memory, set or clear forwarded guest ports, and switch autostart on or off - no need to delete the VM and re-import the image. A guest port that is already forwarded keeps its host port, so a bookmarked http://nas:18190 link survives the edit. Disks, firmware and the install image stay read-only: rewriting them is how a working guest gets lost. 1.1.0: forward guest ports. A VM runs behind its own NAT, so its web UI was unreachable from the NAS — the only way in was the console. Add a guest port when you create a machine (9000 for an EthOS OS image, 80 for a web appliance) and the card shows a link like http://<this-nas>:18190 → guest 9000. Up to three ports per machine; they come from a published range (18190-18194) and are handed out once, so an address never moves. 1.0.9: Console links point at the right port again. The window asked EthOS for the console's published host port through a variable that does not exist (`_ctx` instead of `ctx`), the error was swallowed by a try/catch, and every link fell back to the container port 8094 — on the NAS that number belongs to another service, so Console opened a dead or foreign page. The lookup now uses `ctx`, retries while Docker republishes the mapping, and refuses to build a URL out of the container port: if the port is not published yet it says so instead of opening a broken link. 1.0.8: the console opens in a new tab when EthOS is served over https — browsers drop an http iframe inside an https page as mixed content, which looked like a blank console with no error. On http (LAN) the console still embeds, and the panel says which mode it used. 1.0.7: picking a bootable image (.img/.img.xz/.qcow2) now pre-selects UEFI firmware and explains why, so an EthOS OS image boots on the first try. 1.0.6: boot a ready-made image, not just an installer — pick a .img/.img.xz/.qcow2 file (for example the EthOS OS release) and it becomes the VM's disk, decompressed and converted to qcow2 in one step, with a free-space check up front. .iso installers still attach as CD-ROM. 1.0.5: the window shows a calm “Starting engine…” state while the first-run QEMU/noVNC installation is still running, instead of a connection-reset error. 1.0.4: the console no longer reserves host port 8094 — Docker maps the container port to a free host port and the window discovers it, so the package starts even when another service already uses 8094. 1.0.3: requires EthOS 2.0. 1.0.2: the console overlay no longer covers the window — it is hidden until you press Console, so the machine list and the create form are always visible. 1.0.1: the browser console connects again — the WebSocket handshake now selects the `binary` subprotocol noVNC asks for, which browsers otherwise reject. Port 8094 shows a short explanation instead of raw JSON when opened directly, the create form pre-fills a real storage root, and picking a folder fills the ISO list automatically. 1.0.0: first release. KVM virtual machines with a browser console: create a VM from an ISO stored on the NAS, start, stop and reset it, follow its live status, and let it start automatically with EthOS. Disks are qcow2 files on a share you pick. Snapshots, cloning and OVA export follow in 1.1.
